plugin.name: RestlessCore
plugin.description: A cohesive Valheim interface, nearby-storage crafting, equipment slots and configurable quality-of-life improvements.

cook.name: RestlessCook
cook.description: Cook the haul, make meals and serve feasts. Plan kitchen orders at one table while nearby cooking stations do the work.

plant.name: RestlessPlant
plant.description: Grow berries, mushrooms and more. Plant aligned rows, harvest nearby crops and replant as you go.

piles.name: RestlessPiles
piles.description: Turn familiar resource piles into bulk storage. Deposit supplies, take a stack and craft from nearby piles.

drawers.name: RestlessDrawers
drawers.description: Build modular storage walls with visible contents and the same capacity and unlocks as matching vanilla chests.

storage.name: RestlessStorage
storage.description: Search nearby storage, see combined item totals and take what you need from the Storekeeper's Table.

works.name: RestlessWorkshop
works.description: Manage nearby production from a work-order board. Make a batch or keep essential supplies stocked.

pack.name: Restless Valheim
pack.description: The Restless collection in one install: a cohesive interface, smoother storage, expanded cooking and easier farming.
